faq: Do you need my Shopify password?
No. You add us as a staff account from Settings, then Users, with only the permissions the work needs. You can remove us at any time, and everything we change is listed in the summary we send.
Is this the same as a monthly plan?
No. This is a fixed starter sprint: one round of checks and fixes. If you want us to keep going every month, we quote that separately once we have seen how much your store needs.
What counts as a small fix?

Things like a broken link, a wrong image size, a missing alt text, a hidden section or a settings mistake. Bigger jobs, like a redesign or a new feature, are quoted on their own so the sprint stays on time.
Will you change my live store without asking?
We make safe edits straight away and write them down. Anything that changes how the store looks or sells, such as prices or theme code, we agree with you first and test on a duplicate theme.

desc:
Shopify store management starter sprint is a first round of hands-on care for a live store. Ecom Swift LLC joins as staff, checks products, collections, navigation, apps, theme and checkout, fixes the safe issues and writes down every change.

## What is a Shopify store management sprint?

A Shopify store management sprint is a fixed block of practical work on your store. A person who knows Shopify reads through the whole store, makes a list of what needs attention and then does the small jobs that fall within the package.

It is not a monthly retainer. It is a single sprint with a clear result: a healthier store, a written record and a plan for what comes next. Monthly care is quoted separately.

## Why stores drift out of shape

Most owners are busy with customers, suppliers and marketing. The store itself gets attention only when something breaks. Over time, collections no longer match the range, navigation links point to old pages, product photos differ in style and apps pile up.

The longer these items wait, the more they cost. A visitor who meets a broken menu or an out-of-date price loses confidence, and a team member who cannot find anything in the admin works slowly. A sprint clears the backlog in one go.

## How a tidy store supports results

A well-kept store is easier for customers to use. Navigation leads where it says it will, product pages answer questions and checkout works the way shoppers expect. These basics support conversions, because each one removes a reason to leave.

It is easier for you to run, too. When products, collections and settings are consistent, new work goes faster and mistakes are rarer. The written summary gives you a record of what was changed, which is valuable if something looks different later. Results still depend on your products, prices and traffic, and we describe the work, not a promised outcome.

## What a good sprint includes

- A review of products, collections, pages and navigation.
- A check of the theme settings and the main page layouts.
- A review of installed apps for anything unused or duplicated.
- A test order through checkout, with settings checked.
- Small fixes to text, links, images and settings.
- Product and page edits that you have been putting off.
- A clear separation between safe fixes we make and items we agree with you first.
- A written summary of every change.
- A priority list for the next month, with who does what.
- A safety copy of your theme before any theme-level change.

## What we do

We join your store as staff and begin by browsing it as a customer on a phone, then as an owner in the admin. We write down what we find and sort the list into safe fixes and changes that need your decision.

The safe fixes are done first and logged. Anything that changes how the store looks, how customers are charged or how you sell is raised with you before we touch it. The Basic package covers the health check, a small number of fixes, a checkout test and the summary. Standard widens the work across the catalog, apps and theme settings and ends with a priority list. Premium covers a first full month of tasks, a mid-sprint call and a month-ahead plan that names an owner for each task.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us what bothers you most, so we start there.
- Share anything you plan to change in the next month.
- Answer our questions quickly, since small decisions hold up the work.
- Read the summary and keep it with your store records.
- Decide who on your team owns each item on the next-month list.

**Avoid:**
- Handing over a store with a half-finished redesign in progress and no notes.
- Expecting large rebuilds to fit inside small-fix work.
- Changing the same pages at the same time as we do.
- Leaving questions unanswered, which slows every other task.
- Treating the sprint as a replacement for regular care.

## Who this is for

This service suits owners who run a live store and have a growing list of small jobs. It suits sellers who took over a store from someone else and want it checked, and it suits anyone who wants to see how working with us feels before committing to ongoing care.

## What we need from you

We need a staff or collaborator invitation to your Shopify store. We never need your Shopify password, and we only change your live store in ways we have agreed with you. Please send a short note about your priorities and any apps or features that must stay as they are. After you order, we confirm the first steps in a checklist.
